boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Westwood destinations on corridors immediately beside UCLA, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Hammer Museum
cards.subtitle: Westwood Boulevard at Wilshire Boulevard
cards.notes: Enter the galleries without a reservation, then use the courtyard as a pause point before continuing through Westwood Village.
cards.short_summary: A free UCLA art museum at the Westwood–Wilshire corner.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hammer states that admission is free, reservations are not necessary, and it is located at the corner of Westwood and Wilshire boulevards in Westwood Village.
cards.access_notes: Tuesday–Sunday gallery hours are listed as 11 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Mondays and certain holidays.

cards.title: Billy Wilder Theater
cards.subtitle: Wilshire Boulevard at Westwood Boulevard
cards.notes: Check the Film & Television Archive calendar before heading over; public-program tickets are assigned at the box office.
cards.short_summary: A Hammer-based screening venue for UCLA Film & Television Archive public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA identifies the Billy Wilder Theater at the Hammer Museum, 10899 Wilshire Blvd., as the home of its Film & Television Archive public programs; admission is free unless otherwise noted.
cards.source_title: Billy Wilder Theater | UCLA Film & Television Archive
cards.access_notes: Public programs are currently on summer intermission until early October 2026; check the Archive calendar for screening dates.

cards.title: Geffen Playhouse
cards.subtitle: Le Conte Avenue corridor beside UCLA
cards.notes: Look at the current season and choose a performance that fits your schedule; this is a dedicated venue for staged plays.
cards.short_summary: A Westwood theater presenting a current season of plays.
cards.evidence_claim: Geffen Playhouse lists its Los Angeles theater at 10886 Le Conte Avenue and publishes a 2026/2027 season of plays.
cards.source_title: Los Angeles Theater | Plays in LA | Geffen Playhouse
cards.access_notes: Confirm the production date, start time, and ticket availability on the venue calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Sender One Westwood
cards.subtitle: Lindbrook Drive corridor beside UCLA
cards.notes: Book a first visit if you want to climb; the facility explicitly welcomes newcomers and offers bouldering, yoga, and fitness.
cards.short_summary: A converted-theater climbing facility with beginner-friendly entry points.
cards.evidence_claim: Sender One says its Westwood location at 10887 Lindbrook Dr. offers bouldering, yoga, and fitness, welcomes all skill levels, and is minutes from UCLA.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; Saturday and Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: UCLA Nimoy Theater
cards.subtitle: Westwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Review CAP UCLA’s event calendar, then arrive at the restored Crest Theatre building for the scheduled live-performance program.
cards.short_summary: A UCLA-run live-performance venue in a reimagined historic theater.
cards.evidence_claim: CAP UCLA describes the UCLA Nimoy Theater at 1262 Westwood Boulevard as a reimagining of the historic Crest Theatre and a flexible performance space.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and admission vary; use CAP UCLA’s calendar before making a trip.

cards.title: Westwood Branch Library
cards.subtitle: Glendon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the branch’s published hours to plan a reading or research stop, and check its event listing for scheduled programs.
cards.short_summary: A Los Angeles Public Library branch with evening weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Angeles Public Library lists Westwood Branch Library at 1246 Glendon Avenue and posts library services, events, and hours through 8 p.m. on Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Westwood Branch Library | Los Angeles Public Library
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon/Wed 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Tue/Thu noon–8 p.m.; Fri/Sat 9:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Westwood Village Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Broxton Avenue, between Kinross and Weyburn
cards.notes: Time a Thursday visit for the market and walk the Broxton stretch for produce, prepared food, goods, and live music.
cards.short_summary: A weekly Broxton Avenue market with vendors and live music.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westwood Village Improvement Association reports that the Westwood Village Farmers Market takes place every Thursday from noon to 5 p.m. along Broxton Avenue between Kinross and Weyburn.
cards.source_title: Westwood Village Improvement Association 2025 Annual Report
cards.access_notes: The association lists the market as Thursday, noon–5 p.m.; verify any holiday or weather changes before going.

cards.title: Trader Joe's Westwood
cards.subtitle: Glendon Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Make a practical grocery stop for produce, bakery items, and everyday basics; check the location page for the day’s hours.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood grocery store on Glendon Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Trader Joe’s lists its Westwood store at 1000 Glendon Ave. and describes groceries including milk, eggs, meat, bakery items, fresh produce, and flowers.
cards.access_notes: View current store hours on Trader Joe’s location page before visiting.

cards.title: Whole Foods Market Westwood
cards.subtitle: Gayley Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the store’s grocery, pickup, or Amazon-return services when you need an errand stop along Gayley Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A Gayley Avenue grocery store with pickup and return services.
cards.evidence_claim: Whole Foods Market lists its Westwood store at 1050 S Gayley Ave. and identifies grocery pickup and delivery, Amazon Returns, and an in-store returns kiosk among its amenities.
cards.access_notes: The location page lists daily store hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; confirm same-day changes before traveling.

cards.title: Target LA Westwood
cards.subtitle: Weyburn Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this Weyburn stop for a retail errand; the official store page also identifies an in-store Starbucks Cafe at the location.
cards.short_summary: A named Target destination on Weyburn Avenue with an in-store cafe.
cards.evidence_claim: Target’s official LA Westwood page lists the in-store Starbucks Cafe at 10861 Weyburn Ave., Los Angeles, and describes adding Starbucks items to Target Drive Up orders.
cards.source_title: Starbucks Cafe inside Target LA Westwood Store | Target
cards.access_notes: Check Target’s store page for current store and cafe hours before visiting.
